audit.why: Even lane with a clear pivot: Lulu's poke wins early, Maokai's tankiness plus reliable W-root tips 4-6, Lulu's shields/Polymorph recover late. This matches the packet levelChart.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no real cooldown numbers (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: The 14-point audit requires concrete cooldown windows. Maokai's Twisted Advance (W) is 14/13/12/11/10s and Nature's Grasp (R) is 130/110/90s per the kit file.
audit.corrected: Cite Twisted Advance's 14-10s cooldown and R's 130-90s cooldown as the punish windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer's spikes[0].text calls Maokai's W 'Hexflame (W)' — Maokai has no ability named Hexflame; his W is Twisted Advance.
audit.why: enemyAbilities confirms W = Twisted Advance. 'Hexflame' is a fabricated name and would mislead a reader about which button to track.

edits.before: Glitterlance the contacts — the Pix angles double your poke and the chip is constant.
edits.after: Q poke and Pix autos out-damage Maokai before Twisted Advance (W) comes online.

edits.before: E-mark trades begin: Pix on the carry makes every auto a volley.
edits.after: E-mark trades continue: Pix autos beat his single-target root.

edits.before: Chip and mark the margins; hold W for the dive their kit is saving up for.
edits.after: His tank-item spike and reliable W-root let him engage-and-survive your poke.

edits.before: Wild Growth online — burst math on your carry dies; the knockup punishes the divers who try.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp (R) gives him a long-range engage your poke can't answer before it lands.

edits.before: Late Lulu deletes dives: poly the assassin, grow the carry, and watch their plan become a squirrel.
edits.after: Wild Growth and reactive Polymorph neutralize his lockdown; your shielded carry outvalues him late.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Whimsy answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Twisted Advance (W) is 14s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5 — track it before every duo step-up. - Your W Whimsy (18s CD) answers exactly one disaster per cycle. - Save R (120/100/80s) for the swing moment, not poke.

edits.before: Q the doubled angle, E-mark the carry, auto — Pix volleys the chip while your buttons wait for the real question.
edits.after: Land E on your carry before he commits Twisted Advance (W) — the shield absorbs the root's follow-up damage and buys the trade.

edits.before: Polymorphing poke out of irritation and meeting the engage with a shrug — the W is the matchup.
edits.after: Trading at even HP ignores Sap Magic (P): every spell landed on him resets his sustain and heal.

edits.before: You win the level-2 poke: Glitterlance plus Pix-empowered autos out-damage Maokai, whose only early threat is a single-target Hexflame (W) dash-root and Sapling (E) zoning. Walk up behind Pix and chip him, and keep Whimsy ready — if he W-roots your ADC, Polymorph him to cancel the follow-up autos and Sapling combo.
edits.after: You win the level-2 poke: Glitterlance plus Pix-empowered autos out-damage Maokai, whose only early threat is a single-target Twisted Advance (W) dash-root and Sapling (E) zoning. Walk up behind Pix and chip him, and keep Whimsy ready — if he W-roots your ADC, Polymorph him to cancel the follow-up autos and Sapling combo.

notes: Fixed a fabricated ability name: spikes[0].text called Maokai's W 'Hexflame (W)' — corrected to Twisted Advance (W), his real ability per enemyAbilities. suspectNames flag on wants.foe[1] ('Use Nature's Grasp') is a false positive — Nature's Grasp is Maokai's real R name, no fix needed. missingInteractions anti-heal note (Sap Magic P sustain) is already covered by report[8]'s 'Add anti-heal early into his duo's sustain' — no edit needed there.
